title: Gabby NDE 2320
content: I arrived in the intensive care unit not in any further respiratory distress and all of the sudden I felt my body sinking and becoming very heavy. I didn't feel the need to breathe anymore and I could feel my heart rate begin to slow significantly. I could also feel that my oxygen level was low but I still did not feel the need to breath like most people would. There was a calmness about me that I cannot express in words. There are no adjectives to describe this type of calm feeling. I began to see several doors made of a straw type material. These doors were circling in front of me as if they were on a Merry-Go-Round. These doors were all attached to each other to form a constant chain of straw doors. As I kept seeing these doors, the calmness I felt was extraordinary. For some reason I knew if I choose to go through one of these doors I would die and continue to experience a peaceful calm unbelievable feeling. I don't know who was telling me this but I knew it was either a relative that had passed or some spiritual message. (I'm not a very religious person.) Anyway, the next thing I know, the respiratory alarm as well as the low oxygen alarm was going off and the nurse was putting the oxygen back on me. So that was it. What a gift this experience was because now I am not afraid to die. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 3/10/05 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Accident Life threatening event, but not clinical death Pulmonary embolism. How do you consider the content of your experience? Wonderful Did you feel separated from your body? Yes No How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? I'm not sure how to answer that question. Were your thoughts speeded up? Neither Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Neither Were your senses more vivid than usual? Incredibly more so Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Yes, and the facts have been checked out Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Uncertain Did you see any beings in your experience? Sensed their presence Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? Neither Did you see an unearthly light? No Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Clearly mystical or unearthly realm What emotions did you feel during the experience? EXTREME peace and calmness. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Neither Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? United, one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe Did scenes from your past come back to you? Neither Did scenes from the future come to you? Neither Did you come to a border or point of no return? A conscious decision to 'return' to life God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Moderate Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Uncertain What is your religion now? Moderate Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Uncertain Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? Neither Did you see deceased or religious spirits? Sensed their presence Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes I realized that we are here on earth for one thing. To perpetuate human kindness so that we can continue to exist on earth. This is our soul purpose. We continue to be born so that there is a continual supply of human kindness to combat the dangers of our world. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes A few weeks and just to a few selected people. Some positive, some negative. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No

arrival.other_being_detail: She reports not knowing who conveyed the knowledge about the doors, stating it was either a deceased relative or a spiritual message; she also reports "sensed their presence" but did not encounter deceased beings.

environment.environment_other_detail: Several straw-type doors circling in front of her like a merry-go-round; doors attached to each other forming a constant chain.

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Reported religion prior and current: "Moderate"; also states "I'm not a very religious person."

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Transitional imagery of circling straw doors; physiological awareness (slowing heart rate, low oxygen) alongside profound calm; alarms and nurse reapplying oxygen coincide with ending.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Experience centers on calmness and a boundary-like choice symbolized by doors, without reported OBE, tunnel, light, or life review.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Vision of multiple straw-type doors circling like a merry-go-round, attached in a continuous chain; she understood choosing a door would mean dying and continuing in profound peace.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “There was a calmness about me that I cannot express in words. There are no adjectives to describe this type of calm feeling.”
